note: Anticodons are given 5'->3' as DNA (matching GtRNAdb's 'tRNA Count by Anticodon' summary table), i.e. the anticodon of the tRNA itself, not the codon it decodes. Counts are the number of nuclear/genomic tRNA gene loci found for that anticodon (isotype-level 'Supres'/undetermined rows excluded; initiator and elongator Met/fMet counts, both carried on anticodon CAT, are summed). Used as the tRNA gene copy number (GCN) input to the tAI (tRNA Adaptation Index) calculation.
